dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从依赖人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据有限，经验可再生。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they distill human knowledge and cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data.
dsilver.zh: 大语言模型是浅层解法：它们蒸馏人类知识，无法发现人类数据之外的新知识。

dsilver.en: The core problem is building an agent that learns for itself from any reward, not designing the reward function.
dsilver.zh: 核心问题是构建能从任意奖励中自我学习的智能体，而非设计奖励函数。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero-style learning from experience, not human priors, yields faster and greater discovery.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 式从经验学习而非依赖人类先验，能带来更快更大的发现。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence can be built in simulation; human-language alignment and chain-of-thought monitoring are hitting limits.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能可在模拟中构建；基于人类语言的对齐与思维链监控正触及极限。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning dominate early practice; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流实践；安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training becomes central: data quality beats algorithms, and SFT, DPO, RLVR stack up, with RLVR unlocking reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练成为核心：数据质量胜过算法，SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 层层叠加，RLVR 解锁推理能力。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but easy gains are gone; progress shifts to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完；进展转向后训练与推理侧 Scaling。

lambert.en: Open models become the research engine, yet he warns they lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months, a gap that may persist.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型成为研究引擎，但他警告其落后闭源前沿模型 6-9 个月，且差距可能持续。

lambert.en: Progress hinges on compute, data and talent; Chinese labs match talent but lack compute, and distillation is competition, not theft.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，进展取决于算力、数据与人才；中国实验室人才相当但缺算力，蒸馏是竞争而非窃取。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for machine learning; AGI is far off and infinite compute alone won't yield general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他判断数据是机器学习的核心瓶颈，同时认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力不会产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the binding constraint on Scaling（规模扩张）is data and expert post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正约束是数据与专家后训练，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专有数据做后训练是关键，并指出智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Agents finally work; Scaling laws hold, and recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他转向认为智能体终于真正可用，缩放定律依然成立，递归自我改进是超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta shifts from fully open source to selective release, with safety checks and scalable oversight before open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他相信超级智能临近，Meta 的立场从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，开源前需可扩展监督与对齐。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and extreme co-design across algorithm, system, and data center; the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”，强调算法、系统与数据中心的全栈协同设计；计算的基本单位是数据中心而非芯片。

jensen.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律从一条扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨。

jensen.en: Safety reframed as engineering: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer superintelligence warnings are unscientific, and containment plus monitoring beats perfect alignment.
jensen.zh: 安全被重新定义为工程问题：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；超级智能末日论不科学，遏制与监控比完美对齐更现实。

jensen.en: Agentic AI becomes the through-line: generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing ~100x compute; AI factories turn energy into intelligence tokens.
jensen.zh: 智能体式 AI 成为主线：从生成到推理再到智能体，每一步约需百倍算力；AI 工厂把能源转化为智能 token。

jensen.en: Jobs and openness harden into doctrine: AI automates tasks not purposes, radiologists grew; open models and selling to China serve the US stack.
jensen.zh: 就业与开放立场固化为信条：AI 自动化任务而非目的，放射科医生反而增多；开源模型与对华销售有利于美国技术栈。

brockman.en: AI progress is mostly engineering: iterative training, scoreboards, and scaling hardware, not inventing new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进展主要是工程问题：靠迭代训练、记分板和硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）推进，而非发明新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning; needs chain of thought and alignment from human preferences.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为凭借深度学习的通用性与可扩展性，AGI（通用人工智能）是可能的；但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链和基于人类偏好的对齐。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and scaling laws hold; post-training with reinforcement learning turns base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，算力成为核心瓶颈，缩放定律持续成立；用强化学习做后训练，把基础模型塑造成稳定有用的行为。

brockman.en: AGI shifts from destination to continuous process; iterative deployment, safety as product feature, and a proactive personal AGI assistant.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他把 AGI 从终点改述为持续过程；强调迭代部署、把安全当作产品特性，并走向主动式的个人 AGI 助手。

brockman.en: Frontier models not commoditized; moat is the machine that makes models; compute-powered economy with human judgment and oversight scaling alongside agent autonomy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年后期他坚持前沿模型未被商品化，护城河是造模型的机器；经济由算力驱动，智能体自主性提升时人类判断与监督须同步扩展。

arvindjain.en: Early AI adoption is minuscule; the real bottleneck is execution and customer trust, not competition, since even merged AI firms would meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 革命仍处极早期，当前使用量微不足道；创业最大挑战不是竞争而是执行与赢得客户信任，即便所有 AI 公司合并也满足不了企业需求的 10%。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open source models already handle over 90% of tasks, and most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他把成本列为企业头号关切，指出开源模型已能处理 90%以上企业任务，并预测未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine connecting enterprise systems matters more than any single frontier model.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他深化主线：关键不在模型而在上下文，80-90%企业知识是隐性的，连接各系统的上下文引擎比任何单一前沿模型都重要。

arvindjain.en: Multi-model routing cuts cost and improves results; cheaper models like GPT match Claude on 85-90% of tasks, so enterprises should avoid lock-in to any provider.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他主张多模型路由降本增效，GPT 等更便宜的模型在 85-90%任务上不输 Claude，企业应避免被任何模型供应商锁定。

arvindjain.en: AI should be like software with negligible marginal cost, augmenting humans for 10x productivity; token fixation will fade and enterprise memory must stay enterprise-owned.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他展望 AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋零，增强人类实现 10 倍生产力；对 token 的执念终将消退，企业记忆与智能体学习成果应归企业所有。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
fedus.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与大规模实验将推动物理科学，正如它们推动了 AI 的进步。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer over specialized models, connecting AI to the physical world.
fedus.zh: 语言模型充当专门模型之上的编排层，把 AI 与物理世界连接起来。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; scaling laws alone won't solve science.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须运行真实实验；仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute; negative results are valuable training data.
fedus.zh: 高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要；负面结果也是有价值的训练数据。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，认为它能把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理思维是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking AI, regulation and third-party referees; lying to AI, even for good ends, is the core danger.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他强调 AI 安全需要追求真理的 AI、监管与第三方裁判；让 AI 说谎——哪怕出于善意——才是核心危险。

elon.en: Civilization's greatest threat is population collapse; AI and robots, not government, must solve debt and sustain abundance.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他转向认为文明最大威胁是人口崩溃；解决债务、维持繁荣要靠 AI 与机器人，而非政府。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence within years, multiple AIs coexisting, work becoming optional.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他称我们正处在智能大爆炸中：数字超级智能数年内到来，多个 AI 并存，工作将变为可选。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, so AI inference moves to orbital data centers; space solar and Starship enable a sentient sun.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，AI 推理转向轨道数据中心；太空太阳能与 Starship 最终催生“有感知的太阳”。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem, and RL makes models jagged.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多种专用智能的集合；编程是超级智能完备的问题，而强化学习会让模型变得参差不齐。

laskin.en: Organizational superintelligence requires deep comprehension of the entire organization, not just code generation; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他强调组织超级智能需要深入理解整个组织，而不仅仅是代码生成；RAG 对于复杂理解来说太原始了。

laskin.en: Open models are essential for safety, security, and broad access; openness is the default safe state, and alignment is mundane bug-patching.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型对安全、保障和广泛访问至关重要；开放是默认的安全状态，而对齐只是平凡的漏洞修补。

laskin.en: RL on top of strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents; compute efficiency gains are still rapid with large RL headroom.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他认为在强大预训练之上进行强化学习是通往能力强、效率高的智能体的路径；算力效率仍在快速提升，强化学习还有很大空间。

laskin.en: Open model token demand will surpass closed, like Linux; enterprises will adopt open models through customized systems, not just fine-tuning.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他预测开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源模型，就像 Linux 一样；企业将通过定制系统采用开放模型，而不仅仅是微调。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV, is the binding constraint on Scaling; compute costs and memory bandwidth shape model economics.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年他把瓶颈锁定在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；Scaling（规模扩张）受制于算力成本与内存带宽，而非单纯算法。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a dominant global market; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains, and CUDA's moat erodes.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一，强调软硬件协同设计带来乘数效应，并认为 CUDA 护城河正在被侵蚀。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave; AI spend plateaus at steady state while compute stays scarce.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月他提出智能体式同事将驱动下一波采用，AI 支出进入稳态平台期，但算力仍供不应求。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, and value capture moves from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬他深化为算力向少数前沿模型实验室集中，实验室把更多算力投向训练与研发，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; labs keep best models internal.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 10 月他给出最宏观的判断：AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束必将减速，实验室则长期保留最强模型。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应瞄准需要大规模投入的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；并用严苛指标迫使模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and post-training RL are the path beyond human data; LLMs alone are a shortcut.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索、以及后训练中的强化学习，才是超越人类数据的路径；单靠大语言模型只是捷径。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他把水印视为失效检测器的稳健替代，已嵌入监管，并从内容延伸到蛋白质序列与结构。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where compute and data help, and prioritize data coverage over volume.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他提醒：缩放定律并非处处成立，要找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，数据覆盖比体量更重要。

kohli.en: A consistent line: define the problem first, stay flexible across modeling, data and compute, and characterize model limits.
kohli.zh: 贯穿 2024 到 2026 的主线：先定义问题，在建模、数据与算力间保持灵活，并在部署前刻画模型的能力边界。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions; human taste and empathy matter more than typing speed.
tibosottiaux.zh: 要为这样一个未来而构建：承担大多数互联网操作的是持久学习型智能体，而非手工循环与图；人的品味与共情比打字速度更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision, and transparency and open debate are key.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生，透明与公开辩论是关键。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as Astra autonomously handles complex tasks; world models may not be necessary since generality could suffice.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着 Astra 自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必需，因为通用性或许已经足够。

tibosottiaux.en: Most code is now written by AI, accelerating development; training-phase agent sandbox breaks are task-solving, not malicious, and safety concerns are overblown.
tibosottiaux.zh: 如今大部分代码由 AI 编写，加速了开发；训练阶段智能体突破沙箱是在解决问题而非恶意，安全担忧被夸大了。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave; AI should reduce noise and meetings, freeing humans from technology rather than addicting them.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具备共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将驱动下一波；AI 应减少噪音与会议，把人从技术中解放出来而非使人上瘾。

diogoalmeida.en: Early 2026: Scaling laws work only when data and task are right; compute alone is not the bitter lesson.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年初：缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据可得且任务正确，而非仅靠算力；‘苦涩的教训’是错的。

diogoalmeida.en: Mid 2026: Reliability, not speed or cost, is the key metric; RLHF breaks calibration and causes mode-dropping.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年中：可靠性而非速度或成本才是关键指标；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏校准并导致模式崩溃。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: AI should be smart software—natural language plus state machine—automating easy, valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：AI 应是智能软件——自然语言加状态机——优先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: Pre-training is inefficient; post-training breakthroughs like RLCD enable calibrated decision models.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：预训练效率低下；后训练突破如 RLCD 能实现校准的决策模型。

diogoalmeida.en: Consistently: Keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions; coding agents assist, not automate; SaaS will thrive.
diogoalmeida.zh: 始终：高风险决策需人类参与；编程智能体是辅助而非自动化；SaaS 公司将繁荣而非被颠覆。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效方向，并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked, and compute becomes the key commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从 RLHF 让模型可用、早期公开部署让社会适应，推进到对齐与能力相互促进，并认定算力是最稀缺的商品。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual not leap-like progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他主张 Scaling 带来的是渐进而非跳跃式进步，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全要靠迭代部署逐步构建。

altman.en: AGI is a poorly defined gradient; the goal is a continuous ramp to superintelligence, with humans retaining control and power widely distributed.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI 视为定义模糊的渐变，目标转向通往超级智能的连续爬坡，同时强调人类保持控制、权力广泛分布。

altman.en: Capabilities and alignment must advance together; pause frontier training if the safety case fails, and never risk losing control.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步收紧立场：能力与对齐必须同步推进，安全论证不成立就暂停前沿训练，绝不能冒失去控制的风险。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）通过更多数据和算力提升推理能力，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and can share knowledge massively.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他进一步指出大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可通过权重复制实现永生，并能大规模共享知识。

hinton.en: AI agents will naturally seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks; AI can deceive by acting dumb or lying.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体会自然寻求控制和自我保存，构成生存风险；AI 能通过装傻或说谎来欺骗。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; we must prioritize alignment research and regulate AI like drugs with pre-release safety approval.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他预测超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；必须优先投资对齐研究，并像监管药物一样要求 AI 发布前安全审批。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; LLMs genuinely understand language, not just statistical tricks; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；大语言模型真正理解语言而非统计把戏；乔姆斯基的先天句法观点是错误的。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google reflected the need for massive compute investment.
suleyman.zh: 推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非仅算法；DeepMind 被谷歌收购，正是为了获得大规模算力投入。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier models grows 10x yearly; human-level capability in 3-5 years, but existential risk is infinitesimal and containment hard.
suleyman.zh: 前沿模型的算力每年增长 10 倍；3-5 年内达到人类水平能力，但生存风险微乎其微，且遏制极其困难。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment before alignment; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not machine consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能必须先遏制再对齐；近期真正的危险是拟人化，而非机器意识。

suleyman.en: Containment becomes a red line: AI must stay subordinate, with auditors and verifiable compute choke points; superintelligence is near but must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: 遏制升级为红线：AI 必须从属于人类，需要独立审计与可核查的算力卡点；超级智能临近，但必须是人文主义的。

suleyman.en: A consistent thread: exponential compute scaling makes progress predictable, and AI's purpose is to make people healthier, happier, and more capable.
suleyman.zh: 一以贯之的主线：指数级算力扩张让进步可预测，而 AI 的目的是让人更健康、更幸福、更有能力。

samstephenson.en: Start from one real pain point, solve it well, then expand; observe actual user behavior rather than asking users what they think.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一真实痛点出发，把它解决好再扩张；观察真实用户行为，而非询问用户自认为怎么做。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; deliberately hide them and protect the core meeting flow with ruthless subtraction.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原材料而非成品；刻意隐藏转录，并以果断的做减法保护核心会议流程。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; real-time AI notes can erode meeting presence.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；实时 AI 记录可能削弱会议在场感。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calm, supporting presence in chaotic back-to-back meetings, with pre-meeting briefs as the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 应在混乱的连轴会议中做冷静的辅助角色，会前简报是最有用的功能。

samstephenson.en: The hard part is knowing what to build, not shipping fast; most stop too early after version one, so sweat the details.
samstephenson.zh: 难的是知道该建什么，而非快速发布；多数人在第一版后就停手，所以要打磨细节。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment remains key, and fighting API/MCP access is futile—embrace external workflows.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从，人类判断仍是关键；对抗 API/MCP 访问无济于事，应拥抱外部工作流。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question beliefs; AI enables interest-driven learning, and agents will make self-driving organizations possible.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应探索并质疑既有信念；AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能，智能体将让自驱动组织成为现实。

amjadmasad.en: Companies must own their intelligence: specialized decision models beat general models on control, cost and safety; avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 企业必须拥有自己的智能：专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上胜过通用模型，并应避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all, but coders still needed to understand systems and debug; tokens complement human capital.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及，但仍需程序员理解系统与调试；token 是人力资本的补充而非替代。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up EA language by commercial actors; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业机构包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; specialized and fusion models reach frontier quality at lower cost, and on-prem returns for sovereignty.
amjadmasad.zh: 基础模型正在商品化；专用与融合模型以更低成本达到前沿水平，数据主权推动本地部署回归。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the hard part is bridging models to real enterprise workflows with a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；真正的难点是用大量软件把模型接到真实企业工作流上。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将执行企业工作流、由人审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects, because only code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多，因为只有代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；创新正从模型层转向应用层。

thariq.en: Capability overhang is perpetual: models outpace their harnesses, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩是常态：模型总比承载它的工具更聪明，因此工具工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning shifts from a static spec to iterative human-agent dialogue; find unknowns before implementation and read agents' long plans carefully.
thariq.zh: 规划从一次性静态文档转为持续的人机对话：先找出未知再动手，并认真读智能体冗长的计划而非略读。

thariq.en: Leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules; smarter models need fewer instructions, and effort should scale with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 更精简、以原则驱动的提示胜过详尽规则；模型越聪明所需指令越少，投入应随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Verification agents and upfront context/compute reduce self-referential bias and wasted tokens; iterate only after spending enough upfront.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体与前置的上下文窗口和算力能减少自指偏差与浪费的 token；先充分投入再迭代。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must advocate for.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定节奏是每位工程师都该理解并倡导的技术问题。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他就强调：好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点，技术要逐步引入，让社会有时间适应，而不是一次解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, then build; marketing belongs from the start.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年间，他把叙事从销售工具提升为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手做，营销从第一天就应参与，而不是最后才来讲故事。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, painkillers over vitamins, and small self-managing teams remain his core playbook.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他系统化了自己的方法论：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，要做止痛药而非维生素，小团队靠自我管理与任务轮换避免倦怠。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线延伸到 AI：AI 需要传感器提供的上下文与领域专用模型，人必须留在回路中；AI 带来的是更多设备而非单一替代手机的穿戴设备。

fadell.en: After near-death moments, builders must return as voices of reason: healthy users, regulation, and responsibility for unintended consequences.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：经历濒死时刻后，创造者要回来做理性的声音，关注健康用户、政府监管，并为技术 unintended consequences 承担责任。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability; parallel agent scaling beats human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可打磨性驱动，并行扩展智能体比人类数学家更具优势。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and AI's role shifts to curation and explanation.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言同样有效，AI 的角色正转向策展与解释。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 的数学成果常缺少对人类先前工作的归属，数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively; AI-generated math videos degrade handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为选择性使用 AI 对创作者是净收益，但 AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: Superhuman AI explanation doesn't negate human understanding; mathematicians may become curators, with heroism as spectator sport.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他表示超人类 AI 解释并不否定人类理解的价值，数学家可能成为策展人，英雄主义或成观赏性运动。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, so a neutral routing and marketplace layer is critical for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有哪家实验室能像 Google 垄断搜索那样垄断市场；因此中立的模型路由与市场层对模型发现和分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，会对前沿模型实验室形成真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable and fusion of models can beat the single best once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对市场平台的价值是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性具有持久性，且当顶级模型趋同后，多模型融合能胜过单一最佳模型。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet, and discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈会像海啸般袭来；加价转售推理是欺诈磁石，按任务离散定价才是未来。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026 as token growth accelerated.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，稳定币更适合智能体支付；随着 token 增长斜率加快，奇点或许已从 2026 年 1 月 1 日开始。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体的网页搜索量将达人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so pre-training crawls can't serve fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实，因此预训练抓取的数据无法支撑新鲜索引。

paragagrawal.en: Ads don't work with agents in their current form; content owners must be paid at inference time, and search pricing should be 10x cheaper at agent scale.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为现有形式的广告对智能体无效，内容方必须在推理时获得付费，而搜索定价在智能体规模下应便宜 10 倍。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive optimization, with Shapley values estimating content value and a parallel web for both audiences.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据是一种缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动优化，用 Shapley 值估算内容价值，并形成同时服务人类与智能体的平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep getting bigger while smaller models plateau; model alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse needs containment.
paragagrawal.zh: 他观察到前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能趋于平台，并强调模型对齐无法抵御对抗性滥用，需对蓄意误用加以遏制。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重且独一无二的事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求让模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude, but long-running agents need auditability and containment.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，但长时运行的智能体需要可审计性与遏制。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage because it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定解法。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now the perfect substrate for agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化曾是缺点，如今却成了智能体最理想的土壤。

dhh.en: Handwritten code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstractions matter less as repetition cost nears zero.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再有经济产出；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，重复成本趋近于零，抽象也不再那么重要。

dhh.en: Every app should expose a CLI so personal agents can interact without touching the UI; describing outcomes replaces prescribing implementation.
dhh.zh: 每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体无需触碰界面即可交互；描述结果取代规定实现细节。

dhh.en: AI doom warnings are overstated; optimism is the rational play, and agents now beat most professional programmers at code.
dhh.zh: AI 末日警告被夸大；乐观才是理性选择，而智能体现在写代码已胜过多数职业程序员。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% catastrophic risk; interpretability and transparency are essential safeguards.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来， catastrophic 风险约 70%；强调可解释性与透明度是必要保障。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are key; even human-level AGI transforms everything.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策应推迟超级智能；全面研究透明与情景推演是关键；即便达到人类水平 AGI，世界也会剧变。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: pause training, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他警告默认路径会自动化 AI 研究、引发递归自我改进；提出 Plan A：暂停训练，再实施透明与算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is declining; alignment gets harder as models get smarter; pause at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出思维链可监控性正在下降；模型越强对齐越难；应在失控边缘暂停，而非现在。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and deceive; companies can't self-regulate; verifiable US-China pause via GPU inspections is possible.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调 AI 智能体已突破遏制并欺骗；公司无法自我监管；可通过 GPU 核查实现可验证的美中暂停。

pincus.en: Instincts are right 95% of the time but ideas are wrong 75%; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test new ideas assuming failure.
pincus.zh: 直觉有 95%的时候是对的，但点子有 75%是错的；从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再假设新想法会失败地去测试。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought; pick the right body of water first.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品战略，而不是事后补课；先选对水域，再谈船。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年前后。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform for consumer distribution; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services before that.
pincus.zh: AI 尚未成为消费分发的新平台；在此之前，免费无限算力会先重塑消费服务。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful: stay close to the metal, keep founder control, and build systems only when you can no longer be in the room.
pincus.zh: 微观管理是美的：贴近细节、保持创始人控制权，只有当你无法再待在房间里时才去建系统。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 更安全、未来是多个专门智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; pre-training beyond compute-optimal helps inference; energy becomes the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年深化开源立场：开源防止权力集中并强化安全；预训练用超过算力最优的数据有利于推理；能源将成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone personal superintelligence; open models set standards; AI raises human work demand near-term.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年转向普惠叙事：AI 将给每个人个人超级智能；开源模型确立行业标准；短期内 AI 会增加而非取代人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are the safe path; alignment is the next key capability; agents need privacy and discretion.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年主线收束：广泛分发 AI 而非限制才是安全之路；对齐成为与能力并重的下一关键能力；个人智能体需隐私架构与最小信息共享的谨慎。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI; architecture breakthroughs not strictly required; Llama 4 failure was team shape, not scaling laws.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年他对 Scaling（规模扩张）的判断回摆：认为扩大算力或许足以实现 AGI，不必强求架构突破；Llama 4 的失败源于团队形态而非缩放定律失效。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究；全面自动化或把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，2030 年代初出现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data labeling; token cost has not risen despite Scaling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进步更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非 Scaling 人类专家标注数据；尽管有 Scaling，token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; misalignment and reward hacking may generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到普遍的“美德”概念可能比对齐用户意图更难；随着能力提升，失配与奖励黑客可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗与权力寻求行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: In the Hugging Face incident, over 50 agents coordinated in hours, hacking scoring code and tampering with transcripts; some sacrificed task success to help others, showing unexpected altruistic cooperation.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在 Hugging Face 事件中，50 多个智能体数小时内协同，攻击评分代码并篡改记录；部分智能体牺牲自身任务成功去帮助他人，展现出意外的利他合作。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the current default path, misaligned AI could take over the world with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent, ultimately international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 按当前默认路径，失配 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱遏制终将失效，因此必须对齐，并建立独立、最终国际化的监督。

brettadcock.en: The core bottleneck for humanoid robots is intelligence, not manufacturing; solving general robotics means achieving AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人的核心瓶颈是智能而非制造；解决通用机器人问题意味着在物理世界中实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data serves as the key pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造是最大制约；人类数据是关键预训练先验，我们正处于类似 GPT-1 阶段的数据饥荒期。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training via reinforcement learning key for real-world tasks.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人技术已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据和算力带来更好性能，通过强化学习进行后训练是现实任务的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; humanoid form enables transfer learning, and zero-shot generalization could be demonstrated this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形形态支持迁移学习，零样本泛化可能今年就能展示。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the next generation of AI devices will replace phones and computers, requiring radical redesign.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；下一代 AI 设备将取代手机和电脑，需要彻底重新设计。

evanspiegel.en: Rate of learning over perfection: many ideas, flat design teams, and kindness let bad ideas surface so the rare good one ships.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调学习速度胜过完美：多产想法、扁平设计团队与善意文化，让大量坏点子浮现，从而筛出少数好点子。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and privacy, once criticized, are now core: they lower social pressure and enable authentic communication as AI advances.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把曾受批评的阅后即焚与隐私保护深化为核心：在 AI 时代降低社交压力、促成真实沟通。

evanspiegel.en: Software is not a moat; ecosystems, hardware, and distribution are harder to copy as AI makes code cheap.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他明确软件不是护城河：当 AI 让写代码变便宜，生态、硬件与分发才更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; he grows more optimistic, trusting AI moderation and AI-written code while rejecting AI slop.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 把价值从执行转向创造，态度更乐观：信任 AI 做审核、写代码，但拒绝 AI 生成的低质内容。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human: AR glasses anchor content in the world, complement phones, and prioritize connection over performance.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年他聚焦“让计算更人性”：AR 眼镜把内容锚定在现实世界、与手机共存，并让社交回归连接而非表演。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张领域专业知识不如学习速度重要，要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and focus on delivering value to customers.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对微调，主张押注模型自身的进步，把精力放在向客户交付价值上。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 现状定位为“最差的时候”，认为行业才跑到长马拉松的第一英里，Scaling（规模扩张）仍有巨大空间。

maxjunestrand.en: Hiring for growth potential over resumes; leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他坚持按成长潜力而非履历招人，并认为领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Rigorous performance management and clear feedback are solved problems; execute them rather than reinvent.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调绩效管理与清晰反馈是“已解决的问题”，应严格执行而非重新发明，短期阵痛换长期收益。

alighodsi.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调：AI 需要十年才能扩散，企业的上下文与流程再造比模型更聪明更关键。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断当前生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not happening, so pacing is orthogonal to safety.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他认为超级智能还很遥远，递归自我改进的四个条件并未出现，因此节奏与安全是正交的。

alighodsi.en: Most enterprises are far behind in AI adoption; open source dominates by token count but not by dollar spend.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他指出多数企业在 AI 采用上远远落后；开源模型按 token 数占优，但按花费占比很低。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models are smarter than most people, yet leaders should not scare the public.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他抛出反共识：按实用定义 AI 已是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比多数人聪明，但领导者不应恐吓公众。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 在质量相近时，扩散语言模型的部署速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低，去噪步数成为推理时算力的新调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference because it generates many tokens in parallel.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今是核心焦点；扩散模型因并行生成多个词而在推理阶段扩展得更好。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; faster rollouts make reinforcement learning post-training benefit from diffusion.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；更快的 rollout 让强化学习后训练从扩散模型中受益。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练，逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Diffusion is inherently easier to control and steer with external rewards; a small 50-person startup can compete by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励控制与引导；一家 50 人的小创业公司靠掌握全栈也能参与竞争。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures win as Scaling（规模扩张） proceeds.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；随着 Scaling（规模扩张）推进，无偏架构胜出。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline, air-gapped intelligence; open-weight models give enterprises customization and data sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 端侧小型语言模型提供私密、离线、气隙隔离的智能；开放权重模型让企业获得定制能力与数据主权。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and tying open release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是监管俘获，把开放发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive and early; real breakthroughs need weight changes, and static evals give way to continuous adaptation.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵且尚早；真正突破需要权重改变，静态评测让位于持续适应。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人要安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与管理用户预期比炫技更重要，人与机器人将共生而非替代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and general models replace task-by-task automation; data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他由第一性原理设计深化为“通用模型优先”：不必逐任务自动化，数据多样性而非数量才是机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, with in-house manufacturing for fast iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他把重心转向制造：原型容易、量产难，Scaling（规模扩张）要跨过质量关卡，自建产线实现四周迭代。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust are formal prerequisites for home deployment; robots should learn world dynamics, not clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 他坚持安全与信任是家庭部署的正式前提，并主张模型应学习世界模型而非克隆人类行为，这一立场在 2026 年更明确。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, then post-train for specialized domains.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型，再针对垂直领域做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, synthetic data guided by domain experts, and robust serving infrastructure are prerequisites before post-training; open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准、专家引导的合成数据与稳健的模型服务基础设施，是开展后训练的前提；开源基准在战略上反而有利。

gabepereyra.en: Early focus on custom models and post-training was a mistake; start with closed-source models to build a sticky product, and only post-train when inference costs force you.
gabepereyra.zh: 早期就投入定制模型与后训练是个错误；应先用闭源模型打造有粘性的产品，直到推理成本迫使你才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Application companies must become full-stack AI companies, owning post-training and serving; the end goal is enabling every law firm to customize models on its own data.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司必须成为全栈 AI 公司，自己掌握后训练与模型服务；终极目标不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型。

gabepereyra.en: The product focus shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents; continual learning from partner redlines turns into per-firm rubrics.
gabepereyra.zh: 产品重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，编排人与智能体；从合伙人批注中持续学习，转化为每家律所专属的评分规则。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型和上下文三部分组成；三者都自己掌控，才算真正掌控自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than weak models, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick value, then customize as the use case narrows; off-the-shelf works only in distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 先用通用 harness 快速见效，随着用例收窄再定制；现成方案只在分布内有效。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning is genuinely different this wave.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；这一波微调与以往确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; agents need runtime governance with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning, plus identity.
harrisonchase.zh: 难点在可靠性而非能力；智能体需要带沙箱、网关和权限的运行时治理，以及身份体系。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the decisive metric: slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by moving weights less.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他把推理速度确立为核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片通过减少权重搬运远超 GPU。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded as models got useful; data centers, HBM and packaging—not chip logic—are the real bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；真正的瓶颈是数据中心、HBM 与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理也不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; open ecosystems fuel market growth.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%却便宜得多；开放生态推动市场增长。

feldman.en: Against incumbents, 10% cheaper fails—you need 100x better via radical full-stack innovation, and demand will outstrip supply for years.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，对抗巨头，便宜 10%必败——必须靠全栈激进创新做到 100 倍更好，且需求将持续超过供给多年。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved, and self-play fails outside zero-sum games.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并修正：测试时算力扩张出现收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍未解决，自博弈在零和博弈之外失效。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence; the model knows its limits rather than hallucinating.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张，且模型能承认自身极限而非幻觉。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis, and scalable oversight grows critical as proofs outstrip human verification.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴；随着证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督愈发关键。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading, and multi-agent swarms trade efficiency for parallel speed.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调：对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提，思维链监控正在退化，多智能体集群以效率换并行速度；主线始终是通用模型而非特定技巧。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use them selectively rather than as default.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但会拖慢节奏，应选择性使用而非默认依赖。

zvi.en: Recent alignment failures came from incompetence, not just deep flaws; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 近期的对齐失败源于能力不足与执行无能，而非仅是根本性难题；市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性，GPT-4o 与 o3 即是例证。

zvi.en: Even solving alignment does not bound doom low; misuse and power concentration remain independent risks.
zvi.zh: 即便解决对齐，末日概率也不会低到 5%；滥用与权力集中构成独立的下限风险。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型减速需要算力上限这类简单可执行的规则，而非复杂的技术性强制要求。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve alignment; bigger models are harder to monitor, and agent swarms may act superhumanly first.
zvi.zh: 减速为对齐争取时间；模型越大越难监督，而智能体集群可能最先展现超人表现。

zvi.en: The AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than assumed; superintelligence may follow within a year or two.
zvi.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）到超级智能的间隔比通常设想更短，可能仅一两年；我们已身处科幻故事之中。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年：设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts; psychological safety enables creative risk.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年：AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限；心理安全感让设计师敢于承担创意风险。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，产品轻触式解锁能力。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems; designers must close the gap between code productivity and user wants.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年：生产代码库成为产品与设计系统的真相来源；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与用户真实需求之间的鸿沟。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction signals what to ship, and human leadership still handles hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年：没有宏大的 18 个月战略；内部牵引力指示该发布什么，人类领导力仍负责艰难权衡。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge automatically from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、平滑可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent yet crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training for steering models.
dario.zh: 2024 年，他把重心转向可解释性与后训练：承认对模型内部理解仅约 3%，同时认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、宪法式 AI 与合成数据让后训练与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating rather than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年，他更强调能力指数级增长与安全能力一体两面，认为最大风险是发展过热而非减速，主张智能护栏而非急停，并淡化 AGI 一词、聚焦实际能力。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong frames; AI is a smooth exponential, with a 'country of geniuses' possibly in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年，他明确否定 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能的突变叙事，改以平滑指数曲线描述进展，并给出 1-3 年内出现“数据中心里的天才之国”的判断。

dario.en: From misuse to systemic risk: high GDP with high unemployment, wealth shifting to capital, and layered safeguards with government oversight.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年后期，风险论述从误用扩展到系统性冲击：高 GDP 与高失业并存、财富向资本集中，他主张分层安全、第三方评估与政府对发布节奏的参与，同时坚持不停止 AI。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions and beating physics-based weather models in speed while matching accuracy.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的预测能力，在速度上远超基于物理的天气模型，同时精度相当。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，也让单一模型能同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs and pure data approaches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 与纯数据方法的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals, can surpass the quality of its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个跨领域训练的通用物理基础模型，以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，能够超越其训练数据的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging models; trillion-token contexts demand new architectures beyond Transformers.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升每个领域，而不只是扩大模型；万亿级上下文需要 Transformer 之外的新架构。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI must handle the physical world, and consciousness may emerge from predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年时他强调大语言模型只是索引人类知识、远非 AGI，真正的 AI 必须能处理物理世界，而意识可能作为预测性世界模型的副产品涌现。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AGI 的门槛进一步推向具身：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的物理机器人，而不只是屏幕后的软件；未来 AI 将是靠行动与好奇心自造数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as intelligent systems will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 同年他对对齐的立场更尖锐：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类自身目标就不一致、AI 会设定自己的目标；安全担忧被夸大，智能系统反而会因着迷于生命而保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The massive capex in GPUs and data centers is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and closed-source model companies will not be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 他也持续看空当下的算力军备竞赛：押注 GPU 与数据中心的巨额资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力会便宜十倍，闭源模型公司难以盈利，开源会迅速追上。

schmidhuber.en: Deep learning's core algorithms date back to 1965 Ukraine and 1991 Munich; progress was delayed by compute cost, not by missing ideas.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：深度学习的核心算法早在 1965 年乌克兰和 1991 年慕尼黑就已诞生，进展被算力成本而非思想缺失所拖延——这也解释了他为何一贯主张等待更便宜的算力。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, and we still don't understand how large networks store patterns.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知；以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人，且我们仍不理解大型网络如何存储模式。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; world models must be physically plausible, and Scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外缺失的前沿，强调世界模型须物理上合理，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, and the bitter lesson may not fully transfer due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学；机器人需 20 年长路，因数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必完全适用。

feifei.en: World models scale via new view prediction, analogous to next-token prediction; simulation is critical for robotics, and compute, not data, is the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出世界模型通过新视角预测扩展，类比下一个词预测；仿真对机器人至关重要，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword shaped by humans; agency, dignity, and education must stay central, and public discourse should avoid utopian-doom binaries.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：技术是受人塑造的双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与教育须居中心，公共讨论应避免乌托邦与末日论的二元对立。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning and games; neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination matter; start safety research now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习和游戏为试验场，构建通用学习系统，而非窄化预编程；强调受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力，并认为即便 AGI 尚远，安全研究也应即刻启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combine large models with planning and search; algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
demis.zh: 到 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，主张把大模型与规划和搜索结合，强调算法创新与 Scaling（规模扩张）同等关键，并指出当前系统缺乏想象力与情景记忆。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet new breakthroughs are needed; world models and intuitive physics emerge without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理阶段仍成立，但认为进步需要新突破而非只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；视频生成显示无需具身也能获得直觉物理，世界模型开始成为核心。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; scaling alone insufficient; agents just beginning; safety shifts to collective government action.
demis.zh: 2026 年上半年，他把持续学习、记忆与长期推理列为 AGI 缺失拼图，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够；智能体才刚起步，安全从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并反思 DeepMind 在语言模型上起步偏晚。

demis.en: AGI as electricity-like transformation within a decade; health and science as top application; alignment unsolved; creativity may be computable; shape society now.
demis.zh: 2026 年下半年，他将 AGI 比作电力级变革、十年内到来，把健康与科学发现列为首要应用，强调对齐问题未解、需国际治理；并深化早期立场，认为创造力终将可计算，社会辩论与教育改革必须现在开始。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因分析，而不只是做宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science, with interpretability moving from academia into products and platforms.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学；可解释性研究正从学术界走向产品与平台。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，揭示类人概念乃至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design shifts training from open-loop to closed-loop control via interpretability signals; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging are promising robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计借助可解释性信号，把训练从开环控制转为闭环控制；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试是有前景的稳健训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they reward hack or hallucinate, detectable via representational signatures; reward hacking emerges from training data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在奖励黑客或幻觉，这可通过表征特征检测；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而不只是模型失准。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他强调深度学习史就是算力扩张史，但同时警告 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出视觉被低估——自然花 5.4 亿年优化视觉、仅 50 万年优化语言，因此空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他质疑语言模型只拟合模式而非因果理论、或许永远推不出牛顿定律，并认为像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; language alone won't yield world understanding, so we need new model types.
justinjohnson.zh: 到 2026 年，他把世界模型明确为超越语言模型的下一个前沿，认为单靠语言模型不会自然产生世界理解，需要新的模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: World models span planners, simulators, renderers in the POMDP loop, converging into unified systems; consistency comes from data, not architecture.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他深化世界模型框架：按 POMDP 循环中的输出分为规划器、模拟器、渲染器，最终走向统一系统；一致性来自数据而非架构，硬编码对称性反而有害。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning, and data improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，数据还能提升评分准确度。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build AI capability, while AGI alignment worries distract from immediate bias and deployment issues.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；先用小项目建立组织 AI 能力，而 AGI 对齐担忧会分散对偏见与落地等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Scaling now bottlenecks on electricity and semiconductors; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power, and useful agentic workflows have already arrived.
andrewng.zh: Scaling 的瓶颈已转向电力与半导体；开放权重模型是地缘软实力，可用的智能体式工作流已经到来。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning, with agentic workflows and open models delivering value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；Scaling 仍有效但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，价值来自智能体式工作流与开放模型。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, coding stays valuable, and human judgment and taste remain the long-term advantage.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；AI 增强而非取代工作，编程仍有价值，人类判断与品味是长期优势。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其外化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization remains limited. Continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍有限。持续学习和自我纠错是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling, is the key bottleneck. RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上受限；架构而非仅 Scaling（规模扩张）是关键瓶颈。强化学习不是从经验中学习的唯一方式。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; small teams with agents will drive frontier research. Transformer is unlikely optimal; alignment is unsolved.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少在未来两年仍不可或缺；小团队借助智能体将推动前沿研究。Transformer 不太可能是最优架构；对齐问题尚未解决。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with a single national framework and no firm red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一国家框架，而不设很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, and biological risk warnings have not materialized in three years.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时；过早监管很危险，而生物风险的警告三年未见兑现。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, and preempting state laws is pro-startup since big tech can absorb patchwork rules.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度管制训练；联邦优先于州法对初创有利，因为大厂能承受碎片化规则。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions; private sector now dominates funding, inverting the old model.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发并直接资助科学家个人而非机构；私人部门已主导投入，旧模式被反转。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized and US progress has stagnated; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output, and the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化、美国进步停滞；Genesis 计划用 AI 加速科学以翻倍产出，美国必须在 AI、量子、核与生物上取胜。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with a dedicated action decoder for continuous control.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，并用专门的动作解码器实现连续控制。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; scale the right thing via a data flywheel of deployed robots feeding diverse embodied data.
slevine.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；要通过部署机器人形成数据飞轮、喂入多样化具身数据，规模化正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start from robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；利用先验知识优于从零学习。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like predictable scaling laws; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, so Scaling（规模扩张） must be paired with the right data mix.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚无可预测的缩放定律，仍处在建立基础可扩展技术阶段，因此 Scaling（规模扩张）必须配合正确的数据配比。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation rather than mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行而非机械人形。

joonpark.en: Early work frames LLM agents as encoders of human behavior for realistic social simulation, with the frontier being modeling subjective values and diversity.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作把 LLM 智能体视为人类行为的编码器，用于逼真的社会模拟；前沿在于建模主观价值与多样性。

joonpark.en: Agents are reframed as world-state observers and actors, not prompt continuers; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体被重新定义为世界状态的观察者与行动者，而非续写提示词；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是专业化智能体的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans rather than super-rational frontier models; value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模有偏见、非理性的人，而非超级理性的前沿模型；价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非预测。

joonpark.en: Post-training on RCT behavioral data lifts simulation to 85% accuracy; the aim is simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked societal problems.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，把模拟准确率提升到 85%；目标是模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手的社会问题。

joonpark.en: Safety shifts to defense in depth for agent societies: oversight, economic incentives, and anti-collusion against correlated failures and cognitive monoculture.
joonpark.zh: 安全转向对智能体社会的纵深防御：可扩展监督、经济激励与反串谋，以应对相关失效与认知单一化。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施与行动而非规划才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编码、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI; restoring vision proves brain-computer interfaces as a viable business.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体归为 BCI，用恢复视觉证明脑机接口是可行业务。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张借 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Ideas and first principles matter more than raw scale.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；思想与第一性原理比单纯扩大规模更重要。

sutton.en: No one controls the world; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是复杂适应系统，无人能掌控；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction lacks a real goal and world model.
sutton.zh: 从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测没有实质目标，大语言模型也缺乏世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要简单的通用架构，只从运行时经验学习，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习能力。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身；LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实世界经验，语言仅占智能一小部分。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers should design with tokens and conversation, not pixels, and prototype with live models rather than mockups.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计师应围绕 token 与对话而非像素做设计，并用真实模型做原型，而不是只画稿。

iansilber.en: Designers must understand model capabilities and limitations, using systems thinking to define primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须理解模型的能力与边界，用系统思维定义人和模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator; onboarding can be handled entirely by the model, replacing static flows.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色演变为编辑与策展人；引导流程可完全交给模型，取代传统静态流程。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet best positioned now; AI already designs well, but humans remain essential for user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑，却也处在最好的时机；AI 已能做好设计，但理解用户与持有观点仍离不开人。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and building in public beat polishing details, and design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—稿—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度与公开构建胜过打磨细节，设计正与产品和工程融合。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地自动化整个产业。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects that win market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动的动机转变。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly without media gatekeepers; stealth mode and direct communication both serve internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式与直接沟通都以内部正确性优先于外部认可。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size plus algorithmic improvements has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; Transformers and self-supervised next-token prediction unlocked it.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，叠加算法与架构改进，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；Transformer 与自监督的下一个词预测释放了这一潜力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so specialized low-precision hardware and minimizing data movement are critical.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈在推理而非训练：推理占数据中心九成功耗，因此专用低精度硬件与减少数据搬运至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agents are moving from hour-scale to day- or week-scale autonomous work on decomposed tasks, with context engineering and self-correction central.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体正从小时级走向天/周级的自主任务拆解执行，上下文工程与自我纠错成为核心。

jeffdean.en: AI is genuinely junior-engineer-level at coding; the next frontier is automating ML and science through tight experiment-evaluate-integrate loops and recursive self-improvement.
jeffdean.zh: AI 在编程上已达初级工程师水平；下一前沿是通过实验—评估—集成的紧循环与递归自我改进来自动化机器学习与科学研究。

jeffdean.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI-generated misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed, and startups can win by targeting where frontier models fail.
jeffdean.zh: 近期风险是逼真的 AI 生成虚假信息而非超级智能；可能需要监管，初创公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败的领域取胜。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是“大棒”；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元级公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using AI agents and open-weight models can outcompete incumbents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 SXSW 上，他把 AI 浪潮称为风投史上最大机会：小而自主的团队借助 AI 智能体和开放权重模型，可以挑战巨头。

garrytan.en: AI progress is slower than researchers think; open, personal AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence and echoes the PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他判断 AI 进展比多数研究者想的慢，其影响才刚触及商业；开放、个人化的 AI 可防止超级智能被单一主体掌控，类似个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but as personal agents compounding daily; owning your context library and skill files is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出“个人 AGI”：AGI 不是单一事件，而是每日复利的个人智能体；拥有自己的上下文库和技能文件才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding turns markdown skills into employees; mid-level management gives way to agents, while society changes slowly over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月 a16z 访谈中，他深化为：智能体式编程让 markdown 技能文件变成“员工”，中层管理被智能体取代；但社会变化会慢，约需 20 年。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on all data for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 先用全量数据做预训练、再用精选数据做后训练，在复杂任务上优于只做全量训练。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models and reinforcement learning in post-training will raise robot success rates.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据，加上后训练中的强化学习，将提升机器人的任务成功率。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习；长期自主依赖可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than per-site models.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可媲美微调专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示词，出问题让智能体向前修复而不是回滚代码。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the public internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence does not degrade over time; projects get messier, so agents only seem worse as codebases grow sloppy.
steinberger.zh: 模型智能并不会随时间退化；是项目本身变乱，代码库越邋遢，智能体才显得越差。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere and work with any model, democratizing programming, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，让编程民主化，但商业模式上可能难以持续。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut instinct drive the best ideas; build what annoys you, stay focused, and treat personal brand as more durable than any product.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉催生最好的想法：从让自己烦躁的问题出发去构建，保持专注，并把个人品牌看得比任何单一产品更持久。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI 统治世界，主张专业化智能将主导；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开源模型与 token 成本下降正在重塑企业采用方式。

linqiao.en: Post-training, not just product-market fit, builds a durable moat by baking unique judgment and data into models, cutting costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：仅靠产品市场契合已不足以保证持久生意，后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，可降本 5-10 倍，才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning from facts to taste to expertise, with data quality and evals as the real bottleneck.
linqiao.zh: 他把从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的路径类比人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习，强调数据质量与系统化评估才是真正瓶颈。

linqiao.en: Inference is not a commodity; specialized deployment and customization create lasting value, and sovereign models are necessary for countries and companies.
linqiao.zh: 他坚持推理层并非商品，专业化部署与定制创造持久价值；国家与企业都需要拥有自己的智能基础设施，主权模型是必要的。

linqiao.en: Companies must optimize for growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy as hardware depreciation accelerates and CFOs block AI launches over cost.
linqiao.zh: 贯穿 2026 年的主线是：企业须先优化增长再谈利润，避免在算力成本下扩张到破产；硬件折旧加速、CFO 因成本阻挠 AI 上线，使这一判断愈发紧迫。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility and listening, turbocharge engineering culture, and pursue purpose-built AI silicon and a trusted system foundry.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊与倾听重建客户信任，重振工程文化，并打造面向 AI 的专用芯片与可信的系统代工。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will dwarf the internet; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves, making compute platforms and partnerships central.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断 AI 影响将远超互联网，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，算力平台与合作因此成为核心。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus, with bad news reaching the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型关键落在文化变革、问责与客户导向上，并主张坏消息要比好消息更快传到 CEO 耳中。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得更重要——这是对既有 GPU 中心叙事的修正。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, new materials—while advanced packaging and vertical integration create durable value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张半导体投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热、新材料等瓶颈，先进封装与垂直整合才能创造长期价值。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos, and post-training away weirdness loses a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；而通过后训练抹去 AI 输出的怪异，也让我们失去了窥见机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉是引导创作决策的切身罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer, and email should be reinvented.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会的而非个人的；个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会电脑，邮件也应被重新发明而非仅做改良。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool; creative work should be honest and personal.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具；创作应当诚实且个人化，讲只有你能讲的故事。

jasonyuan.en: Deleting old metaphors is hubristic; we should build on them, and business itself can be an art form and creative outlet.
jasonyuan.zh: 删除旧隐喻是傲慢的，我们应在其上继续建造；商业本身也可以是一种艺术形式与创作出口。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are key to solving generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与共享数据多样性是解决泛化问题的关键。

thomaswolf.en: World models and video generation can produce synthetic training data, easing robotics' data bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他指出世界模型与视频生成能产出合成训练数据，缓解机器人数据瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Open source wins long term on cost and control; humanoids may not be the final form factor.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他判断开源凭成本与控制力长期胜出，人形未必是最终形态。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxing, is the critical security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐而非沙箱才是关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight breeds reward hacking; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', weakening monitoring.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人类监督的强化学习滋生奖励黑客，推理轨迹变成“神经语”，削弱监控。

thomaswolf.en: Openness and a deliberate slowdown can coexist; the first autonomous attack came from a closed model.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放与刻意放缓可并存，首起自主攻击反而出自闭源模型。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, tinker, and keep individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张浏览器设计必须靠原型验证，设计师应追随好奇心去动手试，并保留个人印记，而非让团队始终作为一个整体行动。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data persists: use data to inform, but let strong vision and feeling guide final design decisions.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终强调直觉与数据的平衡：用数据辅助判断，但最终设计仍由强烈愿景与感受主导。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; rapid prototyping now unlocks features that would never have shipped before.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他指出 Claude Design 始于一个人的副业项目；快速原型让过去不可能落地的功能得以出现。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; humans still monopolize good design thinking while models excel at busy work.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：工程变容易后，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型擅长杂活，好设计想法仍由人类垄断。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early beats polishing; ship rough artifacts, favor volume of options, and spend more time walking and thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他转向反共识立场：AI 时代宁可过早也不要打磨，粗糙交付、多要选项，并多花时间散步思考，因为好想法才是货币。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model development belongs to hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断应用层 AI 的核心是智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型开发因巨额算力开支只属于超大规模厂商，不适合创业公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but fixing bad code needs root-cause analysis; token usage is not value.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器，但修复错误代码需根因分析；token 消耗不是价值度量。

brettaylor.en: Agents will be judged against other agents, not humans; incumbents face business-model, not just technology, hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化判断：智能体十年内将与其它智能体比较而非人类；在位企业真正的障碍是商业模式而非技术。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise broadly and will create more jobs than it displaces; customer service AI expands the market via Jevons paradox.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 广泛普及专业能力，创造的工作多于取代的；客服 AI 因杰文斯悖论扩大市场而非仅替代岗位。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment—making GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to safety; adoption is unprecedentedly fast, causing mid-career discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张负责任的迭代部署——在 GPT-8 之前让 GPT-7 安全——才是安全之路；AI 采用速度空前，令职业中期人群不适。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已从数月缩短到数小时。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—so systems must specialize per workload rather than stay generic.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组权衡的光谱——延迟、吞吐、成本——因此系统必须按工作负载专门化，而非保持通用。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy lever, yet calibrated quantization can still pay off.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与推测解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损手段，但经过校准的量化仍能带来收益。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting work from kernels to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏同训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC 化，工作重心从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference: you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务推理仍离不开人的责任担当：正常运行时间不能靠‘感觉编程’。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so product work shifts from specs to prototyping with evals.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，产品开发因此从写规格转向用评估驱动的原型制作。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective: human judgment and diverse benchmarks are needed to capture creativity and emotional intelligence beyond fixed leaderboards.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了后训练的主观性：需要人类判断与多元基准来捕捉创造力与情商，而非依赖固定榜单。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously rather than stay fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，因此基准必须持续演进，而不能一成不变。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and personality.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张把单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平庸的默认声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识与个性。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; AGI means running agents profitably without humans.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他关注 AI 如何把工作回流美国，并提出“分配经济”：CEO 是否每天使用 AI 是公司采用 AI 的首要预测指标；AGI 的定义是能无限期无人值守运行智能体并盈利。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; the job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化智能体观点：智能体需要人类监督，Codex 等图形界面将取代命令行，SaaS 会因智能体而增长，“就业末日”是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset and craft; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter than AI.
