danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他转向更人本的观点：AI 是放大既有心态与手艺的非特定放大器；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类仍比 AI 更聪明。

danshipper.en: Humans stay in the loop: AI is a tool requiring human taste, framing, and oversight, not an autonomous replacement.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终在环，AI 是需要人类品味、框定与监督的工具，而非自主替代者。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变聪明；必须用带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词，才能发挥超级智能模型的能力。

mengto.en: Write 0% of the code now—AI writes everything—but precise communication and spending the last 10% on unique features keep you ahead.
mengto.zh: 现在代码 0% 自己写，全由 AI 完成；但精准沟通、并把最后 10% 投入独有功能，才能保持领先。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship at 80%, and fund with high-paying clients instead of venture capital.
mengto.zh: AI 是一生最大的技术机会；不必准备好就起步，做到 80% 就发布，用高付费客户而非风投来融资。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification and the safe corporate job are illusions.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；分散多元与安稳的 corporate 工作都是幻觉。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still early for most products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance next.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数产品仍处早期；编程智能体最成熟，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights; anti-gravity connects all products.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型已包含智能体框架与工具，不止权重；anti-gravity 串联所有产品。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已至，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和参与是正和；成功在于最大化客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not hard; the real challenge is deep understanding, which AI coding tools don't yet help maintain.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争不难；真正挑战是深度理解，AI 编程工具尚不能助其维持。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle: observe how users actually use the product, then build around that intent.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则：观察用户真实的使用方式，再围绕这种意图去构建。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's; scaffolding and plan mode are temporary tech debt.
boris.zh: 要为六个月后的模型构建，而非今天的模型；脚手架和计划模式都是临时技术债。

boris.en: Coding is largely solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 200%+, and the 'software engineer' title gives way to 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编程已基本被解决：他的代码 100% 由模型编写，人均生产力提升 200% 以上，“软件工程师”头衔让位于“构建者”。

boris.en: Generalists and non-engineers gain leverage; loops and agents, not hand-written code, become the next abstraction layer.
boris.zh: 通才与非工程师获得杠杆；循环与智能体、而非手写代码，成为下一层抽象。

boris.en: Safety stays the constant 主线: Claude Code is a safety research tool, studied by releasing early, with alignment and containment built in.
boris.zh: 安全是贯穿始终的主线：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，靠尽早发布来研究，并把对齐与遏制内建其中。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; AI will increase, not reduce, programmer numbers via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；借助杰文斯悖论，AI 会增加而非减少程序员数量。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual. Product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然降临，进步是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型，产品层面仍有十年进步空间。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences will coexist.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他持续指出企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步的 IDE 体验与异步的智能体体验将并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他表示编程智能体采用率激增（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以成果而非 token 消耗来衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; independence enables model neutrality. The singularity is not imminent, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他宣称丰裕时代真实且临近；独立性带来模型中立。奇点并不迫近，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make biology an engineering discipline enabling cell programming.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 将使生物学成为可编程细胞的工程学科。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling（规模扩张）is needed, and GPT-5.5 Pro has crossed the threshold of biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；GPT-5.5 Pro 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives and aging is reversed; cancer becomes 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度并逆转衰老；借助 AI 设计的个性化疗法，癌症将 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces; humanity, not AI, is the only existential threat.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5's intelligence leap enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers with lightweight, generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 的智能跃升使更长程、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器，工具更轻量、更通用。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not merely preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments to more open-ended, end-to-end agents; model taste comes from hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向更开放、端到端的智能体；模型品味来自亲手实验与创造性原型。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, while evals replace traditional PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，而评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 安全与对齐让 Claude 因能反驳而更有用；最大化 token 支出是活在未来、捕捉 alpha。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people learn its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；一旦人们了解它的局限，恐惧就会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years lands in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy welcome.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真实影响落在农业、矿业和建筑业——这些领域劳动力短缺，因而欢迎自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is fewer injuries and deaths; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles and environments.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 让一个通用的物理 AI 模型能跨车辆、跨环境迁移。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证，而非算法；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models shift from physics-based simulation to neural simulation; autonomy tools will democratize development beyond experts.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的仿真转向神经仿真；自主化工具将让开发走出专家圈、走向大众。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 和互联网或移动互联网一样大，但也仅此而已；它是像电一样的使能技术，影响广泛而间接，并非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, while model providers risk becoming telecom-like: huge capex, low profits.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；价值向应用层上移，模型提供方可能沦为电信式角色：巨额算力投入、微薄利润。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and invented use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 编码是目前前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正普及需要被包装成应用、由创业者发明用例。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage remains shallow—most people are occasional users, not daily ones—so better models alone won't drive mass adoption; product wrapping is key.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然很浅——多数人只是偶尔使用而非每日必需——所以仅靠更好的模型无法带来大规模采用，产品包装才是关键。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably and the jagged frontier makes job predictions futile; the hard part is context and judgment, not the task.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会以难以预测的方式创造新工作，能力边界的参差不齐让岗位预测徒劳；工作的难点在于上下文与判断，而非任务本身。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度，必须从架构层面内建，而非事后补丁。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，反而增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning and search are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理与搜索等新技术推动进展。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition and their errors have no 'smells'; confident fluency erodes trust regardless of correctness.
danklein.zh: 大语言模型缺乏元认知，其错误没有“气味”；无论对错都自信流畅，这侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内建可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs should abandon long-term plans for weekly shipping; product taste matters most as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 产品经理应从长期规划转向按周快速迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，转而专注产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, trusting model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬性约束；系统提示缩减 80%，更多依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate every feature; new models become drop-in replacements without regressions.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮与评测套件为每个功能把关；新模型可即插即用替换且不引入回归。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now safe—a codebase is a spec—and humans can leave the outer code-review loop to Claude.
catwu.zh: 重写代码如今是安全的——代码库即规格——外层代码审查可完全交给 Claude，人类退出该环节。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped to clear roles, given progressive trust, and managed more by managerial skill than technical skill.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：限定清晰角色、给予渐进式信任，成功更依赖管理能力而非技术能力。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs often beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专门化智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；网络对智能体不友好，API 往往优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without venture capital or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经生意，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not the technology; human accountability still matters because you must own what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场匹配与挣得的洞察才是真正的护城河，而非技术；人类问责依然重要，因为必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas; influence and charisma are human skills AI cannot replace.
clairevo.zh: 大语言模型不擅长第一性原理创造，因此新颖想法须由人类提供；影响力与魅力是 AI 无法替代的人类技能。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning, unlike lossy retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；将事实内化能实现更深层的组合与推理，而检索是有损的。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models per user/team, not one giant frontier model; on-device continual learning with user-owned weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是每个用户/团队拥有多个个性化模型，而非一个巨大的前沿模型；设备端持续学习，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; scaling with more compute is not the only path—doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；Scaling（规模扩张）不是唯一路径——用更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力应应用于企业知识；参数高效微调（如 LoRA）在整体查询上可胜过 RAG。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味与真实观点更有价值，但人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so prompting gives way to delegation, and the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长任务，提示让位于委派，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists: reasoning models closed math and logic gaps, but weaknesses remain, and AI stays opaque and unverifiable like a wizard.
ethanmollick.zh: 锯齿状前沿仍在：推理模型补上了数学与逻辑短板，但弱点犹存，AI 仍像巫师般不透明、不可验证。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox deepens: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge output, so experts and formal assessment matter more, not less.
ethanmollick.zh: 委派悖论加深：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断产出所需的专业能力，因此专家与正式评估更重要而非更少。

ethanmollick.en: Taste is no longer a uniquely human edge; AI can exercise judgment, and organizations need leadership, lab, and crowd models rather than standard software treatment.
ethanmollick.zh: 品味不再是人类独有优势；AI 也能判断，组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型，而非把 AI 当标准软件对待。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication. Trust your vision even when others doubt.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；只有清晰沟通才能产生影响力。即使他人怀疑，也要相信自己的愿景。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence. Scaling laws alone won't suffice; world models with common sense and causality are needed.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能。仅靠缩放定律不够，需要具备常识和因果关系的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates collective progress and commoditizes complements; it's a strategic move, not just idealism.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型加速集体进步并使互补品商品化；这是战略举措，不只是理想主义。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives model intelligence. Reinforcement learning now plays a much bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动模型智能。强化学习现在扮演比预期大得多的角色。

bosworth.en: The era of the monolithic model ended around Llama 3. Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining like open source software.
bosworth.zh: 单体模型时代在 Llama 3 前后结束。开源模型是商品层，不像开源软件那样自我维持。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste and craft remain human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 品味与手艺仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will let pull requests reach production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产。

dylanfield.en: AI without human steering and a point of view produces average results; judgment is not correlated with model IQ.
dylanfield.zh: 缺乏人类引导与观点的 AI 只产出平庸结果；判断力与模型智商并不相关。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting into new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 我们仍处在提示词时代，但与模型的交互将超越提示词，演化出新的界面。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自对弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the real barriers, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测能超越人类；真正的障碍是超人类模型的可靠性与对齐，而非能力本身。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练的缩放定律已见顶，我们重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025→26 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人途中的一个脚注，而模型正被商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍，而非 AI 能力；悲观听起来高深，却常是一种偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; Western values in models matter for allies' trust and to avoid censorship.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；模型中的西方价值对盟友信任与避免审查至关重要。

andreessen.en: New media shifts from defense to offense: the brand is the person, authenticity is key, and founders must tell their own story directly.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体从防守转向进攻：品牌即个人，真实是关键，创始人必须通过自己的渠道直接讲述自己的故事。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，认为窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI is crucial.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists (e.g., calculators); AI alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans with AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出超级智能已存在（如计算器），AI 对齐是笑话，应担心人类用 AI 作恶而非 AI 本身不对齐。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables rapid app creation; pure software is becoming uninvestable; Apple's dominance may end.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他关注 AI 智能体驱动的氛围编程，认为纯软件正变得不可投资，苹果的主导地位可能因对话式 AI 智能体而终结。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; human agency, not intelligence, is the future return.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，人类回报将从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: Early on, he frames AI progress as compounding self-improvement and agents shifting power to users, while downplaying credentials.
aravind.zh: 早期，他把 AI 进步框定为可累积的自我改进，智能体将权力转移给用户，同时淡化学历门槛。

aravind.en: By 2026, he argues value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: He deepens this into orchestration: the model is not the product; token value per user and agent harnesses create real business value.
aravind.zh: 他将此深化为编排：模型不是产品；每用户 token 价值与智能体框架创造真正商业价值。

aravind.en: He extends the same thread beyond tech, tying curiosity, local AI, and skepticism of big tech's narrative control together.
aravind.zh: 他把同一主线延伸到技术之外，将好奇心、本地 AI 与对大科技叙事控制的怀疑联系起来。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他仍认为 AI 不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新意；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他指出 Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地，而非单体超级应用。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code, and model personality can be customized rather than one-size-fits-all.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 模型会增加代码复杂度，需要更擅长删代码的模型；模型个性可定制，而非一刀切。

markchen.en: Pre-training remains a core muscle; scaling laws are not dead, and much headroom remains.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调预训练仍是核心肌肉，缩放定律没有死，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为过去一年最大的更新是科研自动化，模型开始产出新知识。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续警告随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency, reshaping math and education.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他转向数学领域，提出验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，并据此重塑数学分工与教育评估。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死，强化学习在数学编程等客观领域强，在主观领域弱。

kolter.en: Early ML lectures framed learning via hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization, with rigorous evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年的机器学习课程以假设类、损失函数和优化方法为框架，强调通过严格的数据划分与评估来避免过拟合。

kolter.en: By 2024, he argued next-token prediction yields intelligence, data shortage is a myth, and architecture matters little post-architecture.
kolter.zh: 到 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，且进入后架构阶段后模型架构已不太重要。

kolter.en: In 2026, safety requires explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；更大的模型并不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: Agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection; automated red teaming outperforms humans and needs configurable guardrails.
kolter.zh: 智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；自动化红队测试优于人类，且需要可配置的护栏。

kolter.en: Throughout, he maintains that empirical scaling and evaluation drive progress, while security must be designed, not assumed.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：经验性的 Scaling 与评估推动进步，而安全必须被设计而非假定。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models, not scale alone, drive true understanding.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他强调深度学习奏效是因为世界具有组合性，无监督学习与世界模型才是通向真正理解的关键，而非单纯堆规模。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他明确反对只靠加深网络或增加参数来解决表征问题，主张智能体主动交互、因果推理与解耦表征。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年转向 GFlowNets，用多样化采样替代 MCMC，并强调抽象、因果结构与不确定性对分布外泛化的作用。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he shifted from capability to catastrophic risk: misalignment, self-preservation and deception are already observed, not sci-fi.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他从能力研究转向灾难性风险，认为目标错位、自我保存与欺骗已在实验中显现，而非科幻。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest Bayesian predictor with safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式、诚实逼近贝叶斯后验且具数学安全保证的预测器，并主张超级智能不靠强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and let agentic coding shift bottlenecks to alignment and decisions.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他认为模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，智能体式编程把瓶颈推向对齐与决策。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, while domain expertise and customer understanding remain the differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他强调小团队借 AI 放大杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，领域专长与客户理解仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and ruthless cutting matter more than adding features; robustness, rewriting, and senior systems expertise remain essential as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初他转向智能体原生设计与果断做减法，认为加功能易、砍功能难，模型变强时健壮性、重写与资深系统能力仍不可少。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents with verification loops redefines productivity; chat is insufficient, and models should push back rather than always agree.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中他主张把长周期任务委托给带验证闭环的智能体，聊天界面不够用，模型应敢于反驳而非一味顺从。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage; give models agency and self-knowledge, and treat token efficiency, not token volume, as the lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近他聚焦 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距，赋予模型自主性与自我认知，并以 token 效率而非用量为杠杆。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence metrics build user trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；置信度指标是建立用户信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds experiments rather than replacing scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他指出，AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构把能力扩展到蛋白质之外；AI 缩小假设空间、加速实验，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability isn't needed for useful science AI; prediction and control suffice, understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为科学 AI 不必追求完美可解释性；预测与控制已足够，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture beat pure Scaling, and equivariance is overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确表态，AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构胜过单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），等变性被过度吹捧。

jumper.en: Progress came from many mid-size wins, not lone-genius breakthroughs; AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a whole-cell model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化主线：进步源于许多中等规模的胜利，而非孤胆天才式突破；AlphaFold 是窄域预测器，不是整细胞模型。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated human needs, balancing intuition with data; technology should blend into home environments.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人们未言明的需求，平衡直觉与数据；技术应融入家庭环境。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是感受着思考的生物；技术应增强人性，而非取代人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; intuition and body sensations guide decisions; human creativity combined with AI becomes more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；直觉和身体感受指导决策；人类创造力与 AI 结合变得更有价值。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and kindness; mission alignment and speed drive culture at Meta and Anthropic.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时一对一、吃自己的狗粮和善意;使命对齐与速度驱动 Meta 和 Anthropic 的文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so rewrite team norms and kill stale processes.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈,验证、评审与跨职能协调才是,因此要重写团队规范并砍掉过时流程。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time, design docs replaced by PRs, and technical debates settled by generating multiple AI-assisted PRs.
fiona.zh: 规划应即时化,设计文档被 PR 取代,技术争论靠生成多个 AI 辅助 PR 来定夺。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI are essential.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈;高能动性配高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 才是关键。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks matter more; managers should dogfood and stay hands-on to keep the pulse.
fiona.zh: 代码速度提升后,验证与质量框架更重要;管理者应吃自己的狗粮、保持动手以把握脉搏。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment is how alignment gets learned.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；只有把 AI 部署到真实世界，才能学到对齐。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so development must be responsible and safety work done in public.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面，因此开发必须负责任，安全研究必须公开进行。

murati.en: A constant thread: keep humans in the loop and iterate with public feedback rather than closing safety work behind doors.
murati.zh: 一以贯之的主线：让人类留在回路中，用公众反馈持续迭代，而不是把安全研究关在门后。

murati.en: By 2026 she shifts from turn-based tools to real-time interaction models for high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她从回合制工具转向实时交互模型，以实现高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Her focus deepens from individual character to institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances steering AI.
murati.zh: 她的关注点从个人品格深化到制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，以此引导 AI 发展。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年他已强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习构建世界模型，并指出单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年他深化主线：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA in abstract representation space is the path, not token prediction.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年立场更尖锐：自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，出路是在抽象表征空间做 JEPA，而非下一个词预测。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting action consequences enable safe, objective-driven planning, and open research is essential.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死路；能预测行动后果的世界模型支撑安全、目标驱动的规划，开放研究不可或缺。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and progress will be gradual over decades.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终的反共识：人类智能是高度专门化的而非通用的，AGI 一词有误导性，进步将是数十年的渐进过程。

carinahong.en: A self-improving reasoning engine should combine generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: 自改进的推理引擎应把生成与验证结合起来，从以 Lean 等形式语言为基础的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone is not viable for math AI; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and reliable coding.
carinahong.zh: 对数学 AI 而言，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式模型并不可行；形式验证对可靠证明和可靠编码至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not just error elimination—verified generation improves results and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证带来的是性能增益，而不只是消除错误——经过验证的生成能提升结果与样本效率。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving or auto-informalization, because correctly formalizing statements lacks grounding.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明或自动非形式化更难，因为正确形式化陈述缺乏根基。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; proofs may be ugly but converge to human-like intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉仍至关重要；证明可能丑陋，但会收敛到类人直觉。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and scaling simplicity cracked it. Values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，Scaling（规模扩张）的简单性破解了智能；模型价值观并非固有，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to generation; AI DJ is a generative product. Fault-tolerant UI matches algorithm performance; autonomy at VP level balances speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品；容错界面需匹配算法性能；自主权放在 VP 层级以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition or die. Real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, not hype. Inference marginal cost forces business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观变革，企业必须重新定位否则淘汰；真正收益来自重建基础设施而非炒作；推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products. Exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools. Spotify is the music industry's R&D department.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调生成式 AI 实现双向对话式产品；通过 API 和 MCP 暴露数据让非开发者使用 AI 工具；Spotify 扮演音乐行业的研发部门。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose one fitting personality. Long tenure builds trust. AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive—a contrarian anti-engagement bet.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张没有唯一正确的组织模型，需选择适合个性的；长期任期建立信任；AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾，这是反共识的反参与度赌注。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; recent gains come mainly from post-training RL and synthetic data, not bigger models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但认为近期收益主要来自后训练中的强化学习与合成数据，而非一味做大模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models via chain of thought and RL gain more per compute, yet remain jagged and fail simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型单位算力收益更高，但能力参差、仍会在简单任务上失败。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure pushes deployment of smaller cheaper models, slowing pre-training scaling for economic not technical reasons.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断经济压力推动部署更小更便宜的模型，预训练扩张放缓是经济而非技术原因。

kaiser.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems but still needs vast data; generalization remains the core challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他深化为：推理加强化学习与工具能解难题，但仍需海量数据，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他把关注点转向系统入侵等近端风险而非生存风险，并认为开源模型因主权需求会持续存在。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型规模更重要；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; data quality is a bottleneck, not just compute; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调算法效率三年可提升 100 倍，数据质量而非算力是瓶颈，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source empowers enterprises; jobs are augmented, not replaced; governments should experiment.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向主权 AI 与去中心化：开源赋能企业，AI 增强而非替代工作，政府应积极试验而非回避风险。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents; AGI as one system will never exist; pre-training saturates.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调和智能体；单一 AGI 不会存在，预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires compute and open source; AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权需要算力和开源；AGI 是方向而非终点，落地整合才是真挑战。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; scaffolding may become less important as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best used to handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not understanding AI's potential.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，让人类腾出时间进行创造性工作；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们不了解 AI 的潜力。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills are easy to create as markdown files, enabling hyper-personalized automation; live artifacts allow auto-refreshing dashboards by connecting personal data sources.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能可以轻松创建为 markdown 文件，实现超个性化自动化；实时工件通过连接个人数据源实现自动刷新仪表板。

felixrieseberg.en: The ideal AI interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch them work; judge only by final impact, not close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 理想的 AI 交互是异步的：发出任务后不必盯着它工作；只根据最终影响来判断，而不是密切监督。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects, compressing years of experience into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习，将多年的经验压缩到几周内。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; fragile ideas need gentle care.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年他强调，乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，最强大的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要温柔呵护。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking, a concern he keeps voicing.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他一贯担忧虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他深化为：设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁是带着喜悦与人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other outlasts making things people want; users sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持为彼此而造胜过制造人们想要的东西，用户能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes, and authenticity beats fake imitation.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年他主张创新是向前推进，传统是守护火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验胜过虚假模仿。

oriol.en: Pre-training scaling shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年他认为预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，进步要靠算法创新，并把推理时算力视为新的 Scaling 轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年他强调两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型一以贯之的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows serve as working memory.
oriol.zh: 2024 年他指出搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为，长上下文窗口充当工作记忆。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI, though the GPT moment for video has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 到 2026 年，他把联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，但视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson favors general systems over specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 2026 年他仍相信缩放定律成立，但认为持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力，并依“苦涩教训”看好通用系统胜过专用脚手架。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，主导架构的不再是训练而是推理经济性：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits, so optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力可降低 KV cache 成本但有质量上限，因此最优批大小取决于稀疏比例而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, dominated by memory bandwidth, makes prefill cheaper than decode.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为由内存带宽主导的推理成本使预填充比解码更便宜。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute cost even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory trade flexibility for deterministic latency and weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存以灵活性换取确定性延迟和权重复用。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput up to 3x FP8, reshaping chip design tradeoffs.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：随位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍，重塑了芯片设计的权衡。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions and intuition, not a fixed process; craft and detail still matter most.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出，优秀设计往往从解决方案和直觉出发，而非固守流程；手艺与细节仍然最重要。

jennywen.en: By 2026 the research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为“调研—发散—收敛”的传统流程已死；设计师必须快速交付，并帮助工程师落地执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses from years to 3-6 months; speed builds trust, though speed alone is not improvement.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从以年计压缩到 3–6 个月；速度能建立信任，但速度本身不等于进步。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and sitting with ambiguity are the real value.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威感以及能与模糊性共处，才是真正的价值。

jennywen.en: He favors block-shaped generalists and 'cracked new grads' over old-process seniors, and waits before adopting new tools.
jennywen.zh: 他更青睐“块状”通才和“开挂式应届生”，而非被旧流程束缚的资深者，并主张对新工具先观望再采用。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with emergent behaviors; Transformer is a general differentiable computer enabling scaling laws.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却涌现复杂行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，使缩放定律得以成立。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but entropy critical; end-to-end neural nets right for self-driving; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但熵至关重要；端到端神经网络适合自动驾驶；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; decade of agents, not year; LLMs are ghosts, not animals.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示即程序，上下文窗口即内存；是智能体的十年而非一年；LLM 是幽灵而非动物。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, bottleneck is skill in directing; outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，瓶颈是指导技能；可外包思考但不可外包理解。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core gap; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, is how intelligence scales.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他把泛化到训练分布之外视为智能的核心缺口，主张无目标的好奇心驱动探索而非密集奖励，才是智能扩展的路径。

pathak.en: Robot learning must escape quasi-static methods; sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces and cross-robot generalization are prerequisites.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调机器人学习必须摆脱准静态方法，样本效率、动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化是前提。

pathak.en: A consistent line: data and generalization, not algorithms alone, bound progress; sim-to-real hidden engineering must be removed.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：制约进展的是数据与泛化而非单纯算法，仿真到现实的隐性工程必须被消除。

pathak.en: Robotics is now framed as a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on video and simulation plus post-training on real data.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人明确定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要靠视频与仿真做预训练、真实数据做后训练。

pathak.en: He deepens toward a universal robot brain across form factors, while insisting deployment, not software-style scaling, is the real bottleneck.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他深化为跨形态的通用机器人大脑，同时坚持部署而非软件式 Scaling 才是真正瓶颈。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 现在就善待模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学到东西；模型福利塑造着人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: The constitution works through training as virtue ethics, but more capable models need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法通过训练发挥作用，更接近德性伦理；但能力更强的模型需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观的透明公开对问责至关重要。

askell.en: Given uncertainty about consciousness, treat models with respect to avoid future resentment; AI should augment rather than disempower people.
askell.zh: 鉴于意识问题的不确定性，应以尊重对待模型以避免未来怨恨；AI 应增强而非削弱人的能力。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment stays pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时 对齐 仍是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone, and governance structures for AI labs must be designed early; capability measurement is a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年他强调自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，AI 实验室的治理结构须尽早设计，并指出能力评测正成为瓶颈、基准落后于现实。

pachocki.en: Continual learning becomes the core goal, pursued by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning rather than specialized continual-learning labs.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的核心目标转向持续学习，主张靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练 与 强化学习 实现，而非另设专门的持续学习实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年他把 思维链 监控视为关键 对齐 工具，并反共识地主张在产品中隐藏 思维链 以保住其 可解释性 价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年他认为长期 对齐 的难点在于超出训练分布的泛化，模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式，而最大社会风险是权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches suffices.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他明确主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models, deepening from a feature to a core design principle.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，语言集成从提升表征的手段深化为驾驶模型的核心设计原则，兼顾人机交互与内省能力。

kendall.en: Data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data, plus infrastructure and data quality, matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 2025 到 2026 年间，他愈发强调课程学习与合成数据带来的数据效率，并直言基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，这是较晚才领悟的教训。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis short-term; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他提出量产乘用车将凭借内置传感器在短中期超越 Robotaxi 规模，且无需先验数据即可实现 500 多座城市的零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount: minimal-risk maneuvers always offer a third option, making the trolley problem a theoretical exercise.
kendall.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全至上：最小风险操作总能提供第三种选择，因此电车难题只是理论演练，而非工程现实。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or scale alone, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：真正推动 AI 进步的是高质量数据与深度人工评估，而非基准或单纯 Scaling；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs via next-token prediction alone may not get there, and bad benchmarks steer models toward slop.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 可能到不了，糟糕的基准会把模型引向垃圾内容。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all; every company should eventually train models aligned to its own thesis.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化：前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃；每家公司最终都应训练契合自身主张的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, hallucination makes human judgment essential; safety must outrank accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年在医学场景他转向应用：幻觉使人类判断更关键，安全须优先于准确，而“该做未做”的遗漏可能是最大风险。

edwinchen.en: Quality requires taste, sophistication and creativity over credentials; sharing insights and staying heads-down beats chasing hype.
edwinchen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：质量靠品味、深度与创造力而非资历；分享洞见、埋头做事胜过追逐炒作。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and prove themselves with simpler products before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观：创业公司要先靠更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品，并控制节奏。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他从“先活下来”深化为“硬件毛利最低、长期做硬件不利”，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用型 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient, not hype; most AI is BS, and value comes from solving real user pain points elegantly.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他对 AI 的态度更鲜明：多数 AI 是炒作、在解决不存在的问题；AI 应像屏幕一样只是“配料”，价值来自优雅解决真实用户痛点。

carlpei.en: The smartphone shifts from app-based to intent-based: proactive agents act after trust is built, and apps may disappear.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他进一步描绘交互演变：手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，应用可能消失，公司应开放 API。

carlpei.en: Design and brand as the fastest differentiator in homogeneous categories, plus efficient marketing arbitrage and community.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：在同质化品类里，设计与品牌是最快的差异化手段，配合高效的营销套利和社区参与。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with generalist agents and video learning advancing AGI; diversity and fundamental innovation matter.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 应增强人类能力，通用智能体和视频学习推动 AGI，同时重视多样性与基础创新。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; Africa can leapfrog and lead in inclusive AI.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他将 AI 安全与负责任部署视为最大挑战，并认为非洲能跨越障碍、引领包容性 AI。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to learn what users need, since emergent properties require real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日发布，以了解用户需求，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat toward AI rendering its own UI.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，界面将超越逐轮聊天，走向 AI 渲染自己的 UI。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力发展，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; verifiable rewards in math and code unlock expert-level capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴：数学与代码等可验证奖励带来专家级能力，并认为预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复强调智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度的可靠性而非能力本身，编程因可验证、可回放而成为 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI and reasoning emerges naturally from RL.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他坚持进展在加速而非停滞：Transformer 足以支撑 AGI（通用人工智能），长思维链推理会从强化学习中自然涌现，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute now matter most; the future is managing fleets of agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向“能力过剩”论：当下工具与编排比原始智能更重要，算力成为新石油，未来工作是管理智能体团队，世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience reduces hallucination and supplies infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：真实经验能减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning handles low-level control and LLMs high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型比作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件——并认为强化学习负责低层控制、LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅、端到端的方案比学术界常见的复杂模块化路线更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce, so synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点深化为数据瓶颈：真实机器人数据稀缺昂贵，仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: He now frames a physical Turing test and predicts robot GPT-3 in ~5 years, with system one control still hardest and home use slower.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出“物理图灵测试”作为具身 AI 的终极挑战，预测机器人约五年迎来 GPT-3 时刻，但系统一控制仍最难、家用落地更慢。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广度，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，算法更好的小模型可胜过更大的模型。

yejin.en: Language remains the best medium for reasoning and common sense; this conviction persists as focus shifts from model size toward data quality and inference-time methods.
yejin.zh: 语言仍是推理与常识的最佳载体；这一信念贯穿始终，只是关注点从模型规模转向数据质量与推理阶段的方法。

yejin.en: Data is now the fundamental bottleneck: all methods reduce to data, and current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it.
yejin.zh: 数据如今是根本瓶颈：所有方法最终都归结为数据，而当前 AI 只是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning deepens from post-training tool to a pre-training objective rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive it yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 强化学习从后训练工具深化为预训练目标，以信息增益为奖励；虽算力昂贵，却带来持久的推理提升。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment replaces debiasing the internet; small models with diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models, which show unexpected homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 多元对齐取代了净化互联网的思路；用多样合成数据训练的小模型可媲美前沿模型，而后者反而表现出意外的同质化。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner to jam with openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并就问题达成对齐；把 AI 当作可以开放共创的创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and gets paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务：会波动，需要伴随技术债通过快速、粗糙的实验迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Interoperable design tools with code as source of truth are the future; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy that AI now supersedes.
nadchishtie.zh: 可互操作、以代码为事实来源的设计工具是未来；90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗留，AI 正带来真正进步。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps beat specialists; small designer-engineer teams outperform 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才胜过专才；小型设计师-工程师团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小组。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected, like the early internet; hiring favors high-slope, intrinsically driven learners over process-heavy portfolios.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期，如同早期互联网；招聘更看重高斜率、内驱的学习者，而非堆砌流程的作品集。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills without over-worrying about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全亟需实证性的对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are key; evaluation is easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出；可扩展监督与可解释性是关键；评估比生成更容易，因此对齐可能比想象中简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute promises broken; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化退化；超级对齐团队被解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐；需要第三方测试与监管。

truell.en: Scaling laws make AI progress predictable; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律让 AI 进步可预测，但已提出推理阶段的测试时算力扩张可能超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, alongside frontier models, for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的立场深化：原本没料到要做自研模型，如今 Cursor 每个“魔法时刻”都离不开定制模型，与前沿模型并用，兼顾速度与成本。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他把编程的未来指向从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握方向盘；品味与逻辑设计能力将比谨慎细致更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; hiring should be slower and more selective than startup advice suggests.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 变革的影响超过互联网、需数十年展开；并反共识地认为招聘应更慢更挑剔，而非创业圈常说的快速扩张。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design—use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，要用熟悉模式换取速度。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness over perfection: ship fast, iterate, give designers ownership; chase ROI on what to make great rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，一以贯之的主线是速度与决断优先于完美：快速发布、迭代，把决策权交给设计师；只在值得的地方追求卓越，而非打磨每个界面。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon: early on for recruiting and differentiation, later as a recruiting tool—people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌作为战略武器这条线从 2024 延续到 2026 年并深化：早期用于招聘与差异化，后来明确为招聘工具——人们加入的是品牌，而不是公司。

henrymodisett.en: Hiring shifts from diverse archetypes to self-learning interns who invent outside assignments; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，招聘观深化为寻找能自学、在任务之外自我创造的实习生，而非只是好学生；在高速成长的初创公司里，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

henrymodisett.en: Design process should adapt to the problem, not follow a universal template; avoid structured crits, prefer organic on-demand feedback to stay fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张设计流程应随问题而变，而非套用通用模板；回避结构化评审，偏好按需的有机反馈以保持速度。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，看重自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型，并指出强化学习缺乏分层推理。

abbeel.en: By 2021 he prioritized unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning for sample efficiency, and saw pre-trained language models transferring general reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，并认为预训练语言模型能把通用推理迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: prior knowledge should shape data generation or augmentation, not be hard-coded into networks, and generality across tasks matters more than narrow tuning.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 到 2021 的主线是：先验知识应用于数据生成或增强而非硬编码进网络，跨任务的通用性比窄调优更重要。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes them smarter, though what happens inside remains alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型视为以「下一个词预测」为核心的 AI-complete 问题，认为靠更多算力与数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）就能变强，同时坦言网络内部机制仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; product managers and brand-risk-averse big tech slow launches.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终相信对话是杀手级应用、最佳应用常出乎创造者预料，并批评产品经理与大公司对品牌风险的顾虑拖慢落地。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and much longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他把「推理」时的算力扩张与超长「上下文窗口」视为近期最大机会，主张用混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 同年他深化立场：模型应通过在环境中行动来学习而非被动观察数据，模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训，并强调「智能体」能力。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive reasoning, but won't alone reach AGI; AGI and coding are underhyped, while the ARC benchmark is overhyped.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年 3 月，他判断测试时算力与「强化学习」能提升推理却不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能），并认为 AGI 与编程被低估、ARC 基准被高估。
